import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ['MASTER_ADDR']='127.0.0.1'; os.environ['MASTER_PORT']=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,12
    W=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,5,I)
    ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); ref.weight.data=W.clone(); ref.bias.data.zero_()
    xr=x.clone().requires_grad_(); yr=ref(xr); (yr**2).sum().backward()
    for cls,dim in [(ColumnParallelLinear,0),(RowParallelLinear,1)]:
        m=cls(I,O,True,W.clone()); xx=x.clone().requires_grad_()
        y=m(xx); (y**2).sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(y,yr,atol=1e-5)
        assert torch.allclose(xx.grad,xr.grad,atol=1e-4)
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad.chunk(ws,dim)[rank],atol=1e-4)
        bg = ref.bias.grad.chunk(ws)[rank] if dim==0 else ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,bg,atol=1e-4)
    if rank==0: print('ok',ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':
    for i,ws in enumerate([1,2,4]): mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29500+i),nprocs=ws)
